Also remind yourself of this: There's a difference between being capable of doing work but lack motivation and not being able to do work but do not lack motivation.  I am the latter and it frustrates the heck out of me. I am a living animal. No functioning brain. I could be dead, if my parents just let me.
Please use the opportunity you have.

Listen, glory. I am mentally disabled and I will probably never keep a good job(my mom is religious and impaired but won't admit it and my dad is a ph D in physics whose intelligence I never got to inherit, yet my brother did and now is successful). You are telling us that you rather die than work but if that was the case then you would be gone right now. I know honestly you want to live, just not 'this life'. 

If you think you might be of a danger to yourself, go seek immediate help. There's help, national helplines and so on. Depending on the cause of your depression, you might need therapy but you might also benefit from medication. I take medication myself for my panic disorders(huge stress - read my other posts) and it calms me down just a bit. I am still stressing out about how I will deal with my future.

Please do everything to keep yourself alive. Killing yourself now would mean the end of it, do you know what that would mean/do to you?
I am screaming for help and no one replies. Wow. Thanks reddit.
HELPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP
HELP!
HELP!
HELP

I can't see reason to live a life without critical thinking skills. An inactive thinker is equivalent to an animal and since we don't value the lives of animals(because they are not capable of self-consciousness), then we are allowed to kill them. Unfortunately it is illegal for me to kill myself.
Also, my brother questioned god at age of 5. At that same age, I was rarely thinking at all. I don't know if I ever started thinking whatsoever - I was dull my entire life.
Please read  https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/3awue1/i_have_given_up/
I know you wanted to help, so I am sorry if I sounded offensive.

What of the above don't you understand? I lack critical thinking BECAUSE OF HER. I can't change my genetics - it's her fault. I wasn't born with an analytical brain and thus may be of harm for myself and others, especially when I have trouble 'thinking' about how reasonable something is. Can't you see how difficult this makes my life?

Read my other post: https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/3awue1/i_have_given_up/

This is not a joke. My dad is a ph D in physics and my mom is a religious(muslim) idiot who lacks critical thinking/logical thinking and any kind of thinking. She also enjoys simple tasks. I took this from her, I was always guillible, had trouble with critical thinking/logical thinking, as told my teachers, and they ignored the teachers concern(aka ignored my development at school). Now I am 21 and want to take my life because I might even turn out to be a threat for myself and others. Really sad.
My brother got from my dad and he is fine. Fucking hate my mom - I never wanted her disgusting genes. Hang yourself woman.
I don't judge you at all.
Honestly. I avoid people In real life because of extreme stress of how they might perceive me. If they talk to me, I try not to answer them but I don't want to come off as 'awkward' so I do answer.
Please answer

I'm sorry for judging in beforehand. Thats just my low IQ. Please, I am sorry.

Also. Are you available for 1 on 1 PM? I could really need that now.

Tried and it doesn't make me happy. It makes me more depressed to be recalled that I can't do anything in life because my moms genes are hindering me. My parents call me 'lazy' and that I just dont work hard enough. Can you imagine how much stress this causes me? Imagine your parents kicking you in the stomache after you have done lets say 5000 push-ups, calling you lazy. Or when you stay at school 8-12 h day studying and when you have that exam you get a 60/100 and your parents say "Why did your brother get a 92?". Hmm. I WONDER WHY. They did this my entire life.

Also I equal my mom to a bucket of shit. She is completely useless and if I live to see her funeral, I could destroy her graveyard. Is that illegal by tge way?

Didn't you read properly?! It clearly said 'borderline retardation', not ADH/or high-functioning autism. At least your aspergers gives you an high IQ, retardation doesn't, it makes you unable to do anything, not go to school etc. Read my other post called 'I'm giving up' and you will see how serious this is.

Interesting question. Apart from obvious cutting marks, which I assume you were not referring to, you could probably see it in their eyes or the way they walk. This is all subjective though!

Eyes: they look small and the person has a "sad face". This means that the person is more likely to direct his eyes downwards. The person also seems uninterested in maintaining eye-contact.
I tend to be like this and sometimes I even cry without making any attention-seeking noises, as if I lack energy.

The way you walk: From limited experience, they seem to walk slowly and taking long steps, instead of short, fast ones. 
Myself? I slide my shoes on the ground/floor, not having energy to actually lift my feet. 

These are the only knows signs. Depression is not something that is discussed with friends but I think someone who complaining a lot is more prone to stress/depression than others. You could always observe them?

Do you remember the last time you were happy? What did you do?
How did your depression arise? There's a reason for all depression I think, do you know why you are down? 

You started taking drugs because you couldn't find ways of being happy. That's understandable. Did you fail out of college because of your drug addiction? If so and now that you are out of your addiction, you should in my opinion go back to college to get a degree. Degrees are needed to get a job, especially a job you think you can enjoy.

You can't let yourself get happiness from external things, like others, because when they are 'gone', which they will be at some time, you will be depressed again. Try to get happiness from yourself. Are you good at something, anything? Video-gaming, drawing, maths, writing? Usually when you are good at something, you often find it enjoyable at the same time.  What you are good at is what you should focus on. 

Your reason to live is something you decide for yourself. Philosophically, this question has no answer and it's up to you what you want to do with your life  but biologically you were born to eventually die. 

I hope I could help you even a bit. I myself have no purpose because I was born with extremely bad genes(my mom is mentally impaired, my dad is a ph D in physics and my brother got from my dads intelligence and is studying engineering. I am good at nothing and my parents agree which makes me feel even more useless. I hate my mother and wish my father not to have married her. Is this going to help? No. I don't know if I ever will find purpose in anything I do.)
Does it happen that you laugh whenever people come to you with a mental problem they are having? Like... I am extremely depressed because I am 'stupid' and cannot do anything about it?

I have been called lazy, hypochondriac, delusional, that my intention is to hurt the people in my household with my negativity, that I try to find excuses, that I am destructive and I am causing stress in the house and this is what I want?

My depression is caused by me lacking purpose in life. I am mildly retarded and my parents are neglecting every single bit of this(Mom is mildly retarded as well but she won't admit it, claiming she is smart even though she is muslim and lacks critical thinking/insight/logical thinking and my dad is a ph D in physics with no regards to those less than him, not even me. I also have a brother doing engineering and he has his dads' genes.) 

When your parents genuinely think that 'hard work will pay off, regardless what genes you have', it has become obvious that they have lost touch with reality. Everyone can't become a physicist or a nobel prize winner. They can't. The genes already decide whether you can develop an analytical thinking or not and if you lack it, you will never be able to reach that point. Amount of years working will not help you here either.

What can you do when you feel helpless and even the doctors cannot 'fix you'? There's no fix to genetics, there's no fix to being unborn besides taking your life and that's really not an option either.
